svg.aria-label: Tech stack drawn as an isometric equipment rack with one module per technology, in 5 numbered sections. Backend: PHP, Symfony, Laravel, Node.js, Python, API Platform, PHPUnit, Codeception. Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue.js, Nuxt.js, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Ionic, Capacitor, Flutter, Cypress. DevOps & Tools: Docker, Traefik, Jenkins, Postfix, GitHub Actions, Linux, Nginx, Apache. Database: MySQL, Redis, MariaDB. IDE & Development: PhpStorm, VS Code, Git, GitHub. The lamp of Symfony, used every day, is lit.
